      "unit_kind": "redaction",

  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-01",
      "risk": "Device credential theft lets an attacker inject samples as that device.",
      "likelihood": "medium",
      "impact": "high",
      "mitigation": "AZ-01 credential proof and rotation duties",
      "residual": "Samples within a stolen credential's lifetime remain accepted."

      "id": "R-02",

      "impact": "medium",
      "mitigation": "accepted: SI-02 validates only metrics with stated boundaries",
      "residual": "Out-of-range ground contact, respiration, stroke values stored as valid."

      "id": "R-03",

      "impact": "medium",

      "mitigation": "AZ-02 service credential proof duty",
